$comment: Documentation-grade schema for <run>/research/EV<n>.json (content-workflow-research/v1). Written only by scripts/research_fetch.py after a successful live retrieval; validated by scripts/cw_research.py with a hand-written checker. A record proves that the page was fetched in this run and contained the excerpt and currency marker. It does not prove that the page supports any claim. 'Retrieved in this run' means the metadata is consistent with the run's nonce and opening time; the run directory is writable, so this is consistency evidence, not authenticated provenance.

nonce.description: must equal run.json research.nonce (issued by research_fetch.py --init); a different nonce is reused evidence

source_id.description: run.json source this record supports, when one exists

fetched_url.description: fixture runs only: the local test-server URL the reserved fixture URL was mapped to

retrieved_at.description: ISO timestamp of the retrieval in this run; must be on or after research.opened_at and within research.max_age_days at check time

text_path.description: run-relative path of the extracted page text

excerpt.description: verbatim text (40+ characters) present in the extracted text at retrieval; required except for link-destination

authority.description: the citation as the page names it; required for legal-authority

jurisdiction.description: required for legal-authority; declared by the operator and checked for consistency with the run's jurisdiction (or 'federal'); correctness is the legal reviewer's judgment

legislation_status.description: only 'effective' may support a claim of current law

effective_date.description: ISO date the provision itself took effect, only when the page states one; null otherwise; must not be after the retrieval date

future_effective_date.description: ISO date for enacted-not-effective law; must be in the future

marker.description: the page's own current-through / published / effective statement, verbatim (20+ characters); required for a legal authority unless marker_absent_reason is given; must be present at retrieval and at live re-check; the excerpt may not be the marker

amendments_note.description: history line or recent acts noted on the page

current_through_date.description: ISO date the compilation on the page is current through (bound to the marker); not the provision's own effective date

marker_absent_reason.description: 20+ characters; required when the page carries no current-through, published, or effective statement; printed in the ledger

supports_claims.description: planned-claim or finding ids this retrieval was made for
